data.title: Benchmark Yield Hits 5%. How Will Stocks Respond To A Fed Rate Hike?
data.description: On Monday, the 10-year Treasury yield reached 5%, marking the first time since October 2023. There is speculation about whether the stock market will experience further declines if the Federal Reserve increases interest rates. The impact of a potential Fed rate hike on stocks is a topic of interest for investors and financial analysts alike.

data.title: Oracle Stock Falls After Ellison Scraps Plan To Sell Up To $7.5 Billion In Stock
data.description: The price of Oracle stock dropped significantly following Chairman Larry Ellison's decision to cancel his intention to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of his stake. This move led to a decline in Oracle's stock value, causing concern among investors. The decision to scrap the plan had a noticeable impact on the company's performance in the stock market.

data.title: Paradromics Achieves Real-Time Speech with Connexus® Brain-Computer Interface
data.description: In Austin, Texas, Paradromics Inc., a company specializing in neurotechnology, revealed that the initial recipient of the Connexus® BCI has effectively utilized the system for immediate speech and text interaction. This advancement occurred within the Connect-One Early Feasibility Study, carried out with FDA approval under an Investigational Device Exemption (IDE). Paradromics Inc. is focused on creating a high-data-rate brain-computer interface (BCI) platform to improve human capabilities, marking a significant achievement in the field.
